📐 COMPLETE BUY, STOP-LOSS & TARGET FORMULA SPECIFICATION

1. 1–2 Month Swing Trade Formulas

Entry Zone = [20-DMA / Retest, CMP + 0.5×ATR(14)]
Hard SL = Swing Low − 1.5×ATR(14) (5%–8% Max Risk)
T1 = Entry Mid + 2.0×Risk | T2 = Entry Mid + 3.5×Risk

Anchored strictly to Stage 2 volatility structure. Entries are rejected if extended >1.5×ATR(14) above the 20-DMA.

2. 8–12 Month Core Investment Formulas

Accumulation = [Intrinsic FV × 0.85, FV × 0.95] / 150-DMA
Dual Stop = 150-DMA − 1×ATR OR KPI Thesis Stop
Base = FY28E EPS × Justified P/E | Bull = +15% Rerating

Uses sector-matched intrinsic valuation: P/B-ROE Gordon Growth (Banks), EV/EBITDA + DCF (Telecom/Auto/Power), and Forward P/E + PEG (IT/Exchanges/Precision/Defence/Pharma).

3. Astro-Quant Gatekeeper (Timing & Account Only)
